metadata.title: The human layer: leakers, authors, operators, informants

notes: Ported/expanded from bubble-map #241 notable-individuals. People are graded on public court record only. Presence here is not a moral verdict; got_away/did_not_get_away track legal outcome, not judgement.

entities.name: Julian_Assange
entities.notes: Founded WikiLeaks (2006), editor/public face through the 2010 megaleaks. Extradition fight ended 2024 with a US plea deal (time served), freeing him to Australia.

entities.name: Edward_Snowden
entities.notes: NSA contractor (Booz Allen) who leaked the 2013 mass-surveillance archive (PRISM, upstream/backbone collection, XKEYSCORE). The disclosure that reshaped the global privacy / crypto / PQC debate. Stranded in Moscow 2013; Russian citizenship 2022 - a jurisdictional fact, not endorsement.

entities.name: Chelsea_Manning
entities.notes: Army intelligence analyst who leaked the Iraq/Afghan War Logs, Collateral Murder, and Cablegate to WikiLeaks (2010). Convicted 2013 (35 yrs); sentence commuted by Obama (2017).

entities.name: Josh_Schulte
entities.notes: Former CIA software engineer convicted (2022) as the source of the Vault 7 leak to WikiLeaks - the largest data theft in CIA history. Separate CSAM conviction (both court fact).

entities.name: Maksim_Yakubets
entities.notes: Accused leader of Evil Corp (Dridex/Zeus lineage). OFAC-sanctioned + DOJ-indicted (2019), $5M reward, reported FSB links. 2024 UK/US actions named further associates and a LockBit tie. At large in Russia.

entities.name: Marcus_Hutchins
entities.notes: MalwareTech. Registered the kill-switch domain that stopped WannaCry's spread (May 2017) - the accidental-hero moment. Months later DOJ arrested him over earlier authorship of the Kronos banking trojan; pleaded guilty (2019), time served. Author-turned-defender arc.

entities.name: Onel_de_Guzman
entities.notes: Manila college student who wrote the ILOVEYOU worm (2000). Arrested but never charged (no applicable Philippine law at the time); confirmed authorship on record 2020. The human origin of the law-lags-tech precedent.

entities.name: Paras_Jha
entities.notes: Co-author of the Mirai IoT botnet; pleaded guilty (2017). Originally built to attack Minecraft DDoS-protection markets before it escaped control.

entities.name: Hector_Monsegur
entities.notes: 'Sabu' - leader/hub of LulzSec (and AntiSec). After his 2011 arrest he became an FBI informant; his cooperation led to arrests of fellow members. The canonical flip of a hacktivist leader to dismantle a leaderless crew from within.

entities.name: Mirai
entities.notes: 2016 IoT botnet: enslaved insecure devices via default creds into a massive DDoS engine. Hit Krebs-on-Security, OVH, and via Dyn (Oct 21 2016) knocked out Twitter/Netflix/Reddit across the US East Coast. Source code was released publicly, spawning countless variants.

entities.name: FBI
entities.notes: US domestic law-enforcement/counterintelligence. Its canonical hacktivist play is the flipped insider (Sabu -> LulzSec takedown); also runs botnet-takedown and ransomware-disruption operations.

entities.name: ILOVEYOU_Worm
entities.notes: May 2000 email worm ('LOVE-LETTER-FOR-YOU.txt.vbs'). Overwrote files, mailed itself to the whole Outlook address book; ~$5-10B in damage. The law-lags-tech precedent: author never charged.
